title: The Secret Floor (KINO)
synopsis: When 12-year-old Karli moves to the Austrian Alps to help his parents restore a crumbling grand hotel, he stumbles upon a freight elevator with an extraordinary secret: it travels back to 1938. There he befriends Hannah, a young Jewish girl, and Georg, a hardworking shoeshine boy. When Georg is wrongly accused of theft, the three set out to find the real culprit and uncover something far more dangerous lurking behind the hotel's gleaming facade. Austrian director Norbert Lechner weaves history and adventure into a gripping mystery that never talks down to its young audience. A festival favourite, winning prizes at Goldener Spatz, Zlin and Giffoni.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 當12歲男孩加利和父母一起為在阿爾卑斯山的破落過氣豪華酒店修葺時，加利竟誤打誤撞穿越時空，回到1938，並在那裡認識了猶太女孩漢娜和在酒店大堂為賓客擦鞋的男孩基奧克。當基奧克被誣陷偷錢時，他們誓要找出真兇，還基奧清白的同時，更發現了酒店牆壁隱藏著不可告人的秘密。奧地利導演諾拔力拿巧妙融合奇幻童趣及戰爭歷史，在回到未來之前，揭開納粹陰謀驚人真相。電影在多個國際影展參展，贏盡大人細路觀眾掌聲。
